instruction: Use the left arm to hold the brown cylindrical bottle with label and shake sideways.

source.instruction: Use the left arm to hold the brown cylindrical bottle with label and shake sideways.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the bottle, which was at x = -11 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the left gripper in x and y toward (-7, 4, 94) to align above the bottle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+23, +23, +0) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, 3, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper roll, pitch, and yaw to align the fingers with the bottle's orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, -0, -1) cm, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, 3, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Continue rotating roll to align with the bottle, lower gripper to z=88 cm, and adjust y slightly.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -6) cm, now 14 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, 4, 88) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Make a fine adjustment along x by -0.5 cm to center between fingers.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 13 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, 4, 88) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower gripper to z=78.5 cm over the bottle and close the fingers to grasp it.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +2, -10) cm, now 15 cm (horizontal) / +0 cm (vertical) from the bottle

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, 5, 78) opening 0.83; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the bottle slightly to z=79.5 cm to initiate the shake interaction.
